title: Sized two fraud services for Prime Day from load tests, $12,344 a year saved
summary: When the org scaled up for Prime Day, I load-tested two fraud services, set each host count from the results and cut 18 hosts.
what_would_have_happened: Both services would be over-provisioned for peak by habit.
what_i_did: Ran the load tests, worked out the right host count for each service and resized both fleets.
what_changed: 18 hosts removed and $12,344 a year saved, with capacity checked against peak traffic.
